summary: The exact candidate fixes the reported max_length=2048 behavior and ordinary list, tuple, and nested cases, but max_length=1 still bypasses both collection-count and string-size bounds because half_length is zero and [-0:] retains the full tail. The candidate is therefore a partial fix to the original stated all-branches contract.

tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced the original bypass on recorded base: at max_length=8, JSON grew from 120 bytes at eight elements to 80,039 bytes at nine; text list cases were about 80 KB. Confirmed the source import was /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/utils/request_logger.py.
Ran the candidate's own regression suite at exact commit 90b5ae3; all four tests passed from the prepared source import path.

Ran the candidate's million-character fixture: max_length=2048 JSON elided output was 4,208,647 bytes with retained elements of length 2,051 and one marker; text output was 20,590 bytes with no full input element.

tests.command: independent ordinary, nested, tuple, and max_length=1 assertions at exact candidate
tests.what_was_measured: Ordinary and nested max_length=8 assertions passed. The adversarial max_length=1 assertion failed: JSON returned three items with a maximum retained string length of 10,003, and text output length was 20,029.
Both changed Python source and the new regression test compiled successfully.
Found trailing whitespace in two candidate report artifacts; no functional source whitespace error was reported.

gpu_execution.evidence: The affected implementation consists solely of pure-Python serialization helpers. The environment exposed one AMD Instinct MI350X GPU, but GPU execution would not select another code path or add issue-specific evidence.

remaining_counterexamples: At max_length=1, _transform_data_for_logging(['x'*10000, 'x'*10000], 1) returns three items and retains a 10,003-character transformed string because data[-0:] selects the full input and string[-0:] selects the full tail.
At max_length=1, _dataclass_to_string_truncated(['x'*10000, 'x'*10000], 1) emits 20,029 characters for the same zero-half/-0 slicing reason.
remaining_limitations: No HTTP server or model was run because the defect is isolated to pure-Python formatting helpers and the original reproduction is CPU-only.
No GPU computation was run; the available MI350X/ROCm environment is architecturally irrelevant to these helpers.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes no native source or extension.
The review did not assess semantic compatibility of unrelated string/repr formatting changes beyond payloads tied to the original truncation contract.
